title: A Garden for the Spire
author: Xanthe Quintana
blurb: Zephyrine Galloway, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
